ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at the margins and in vertical streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field across the central and inner lobe areas. Low-intensity black banding along the lateral and trailing edges. Discrete vertical dark-pixel streaks originating near the median notch and central right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree angle and a depth of roughly 12% of the visible lobe length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge, with pixel-amplitude peaks reaching up to 20 pixels on the distal right lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered, upward-inclined distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, irregular circular pixel groupings (white/tan/brown) concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-intensity, near-vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation on the central right lobe and adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lobe tips and distinct dark rake marks across the ventral surface.
